title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms

Preferred Qualifications

Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DevOps Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DevOps Engineer:


We are looking for a full-time, remote DevOps Engineer with 3 to 5 years of work experience to work with our U.S. client. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing highly secure, scalable, and reliable cloud platform solutions on AWS. You will collaborate with the Head of DevOps and other technical leaders to build and maintain infrastructure, automation, monitoring, and security processes. Additionally, you will play a key role in supporting ISO 27001 / ISMS / SOC2 Type II compliance efforts.


This role requires strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. While an infrastructure background is beneficial, you should also be comfortable writing scripts and basic software code to enhance and streamline operations.


Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, building new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and the Australia / New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with the Head of DevOps to define detailed technical requirements, plan work, and prioritize tasks according to business needs
  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS cloud platform solutions
  • Ensure strict security compliance and best practices in cloud infrastructure
  • Drive automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and system reliability
  • Strive for zero downtime when deploying solutions or services
  • Develop and own scalable processes for: Capacity planning, Configuration management, Monitoring, and observability
  • Provide day-to-day operational support and perform systems administration tasks
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support the platform 24/7
  • Ensure high-quality monitoring coverage for infrastructure and applications
  • Identify potential failure points in infrastructure and proactively develop mitigation strategies
  • Collaborate with internal IT teams for operational support
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type II security frameworks


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 3 to 5 years of DevOps experience
  • Strong AWS experience in infrastructure, security, and automation
  • Technical infrastructure knowledge across servers, storage, and networks
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Podman, etc.)
  • Experience with SQL
  • Comfortable working in high-security and high-compliance environments
  • Hands-on experience scripting and coding for DevOps automation
  • Experience in database administration, performance tuning, and resilience design
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts and best practices
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting for large distributed systems
  • Strong networking fundamentals (IP, traffic flow, network ports, protocols like HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, FTP)
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and drive resolution
  • Experience managing large-scale tasks from inception to completion
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, engineering, or related fields
  • Experience with automation tooling (e.g., HashiCorp products, configuration management tools)
  • Experience with automated testing in DevOps workflows
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), shift-left principles, and immutable infrastructure
  • Experience working in ISO 27001, PCI compliance, or SOC2 Type II environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient:

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

This is not a traditional backend development role.

You will help design, build, and operate AI-driven engineering workflows that automate software development activities using modern LLMs and agent frameworks. The role combines backend engineering, AI workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, and critical review of AI-generated code.

  • Design and maintain AI-assisted development workflows for .NET applications

  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to follow enterprise standards and patterns

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET Core

  • Strong Azure Cloud experience, including services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Managed Identities, etc.

  • Working proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or AI workflows

  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Advanced English communication skills


Nice to Have

  • AI-assisted code generation or PR automation experience
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)

  • enjoy solving complex technical problems;

  • have a hands-on mindset;
  • can critically evaluate AI-generated outputs rather than blindly trusting them.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Investment Banking Intern em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior - Protheus em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Buscamos um Analista de Desenvolvimento Sênior III com sólido domínio no ecossistema TOTVS Protheus para atuar em projetos estratégicos de alta complexidade. Este profissional será responsável por desenhar e implementar soluções robustas, garantindo a performance, escalabilidade e integridade do ERP, além de atuar como referência técnica para o time.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver, sustentar e otimizar rotinas complexas utilizando ADVPL e TLPP.
  • Arquitetar, implementar e sustentar integrações via APIs REST e Web Services para comunicação com sistemas externos, processos automáticos complexos JOBS e SCHEDULES.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código através de práticas de Code Review e aplicação de padrões de projeto (MVC, Orientação a Objetos).
  • Colaborar estrategicamente com as áreas de negócio para traduzir necessidades funcionais (Financeiro, Fiscal, Faturamento, etc.) em soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Promover a mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores Plenos e Juniores, disseminando boas práticas e novos conhecimentos.
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias em Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Linguagens : Domínio avançado em ADVPL e TLPP (Ênfase em classes e REST).
  • Arquitetura: Experiência sólida em Orientação a Objetos e integrações REST/SOAP.
  • Ambiente escalável de alta demanda (Jobs/Schedules com multi-thread)
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento profundo em SQL Server ou Oracle (Queries, Procedures e Tuning).
  • Gestão de Código: Experiência com ferramentas de controle de versão (Git, GitLab ou Azure DevOps).
  • Testes Unitários / TDD: Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Front-end com PO-UI (Angular).
  • Experiência com Protheus em ambiente Cloud.
  • Conhecimento funcional avançado nos módulos principais (SIGAEST, SIGAPCP, SIGAFIS, SIGAFAT, SIGAFIN, SIGAGPE entre outros).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD aplicadas ao Protheus.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em administração de bancos de dados, com ênfase na utilização do Salesforce Data Cloud
  • Habilidades avançadas de consulta em SQL para realizar análises e extrações de dados
  • Conhecimento em integração de sistemas e processos de ETL (Extração, Transformação e Carga) para o Salesforce Data Cloud

Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

title: Analista de Controladoria Sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Controladoria Sr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing.
  • Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva.
  • Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira.
  • Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio.
  • Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix.
  • Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).
  • Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.
  • Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.
  • Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.
  • Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.
  • Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.
  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Tech Lead | Identity Platform
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead | Identity Platform em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos evoluindo a plataforma de identidade que sustenta a experiência entre produtos, sistemas e integrações do ecossistema Sankhya. Buscamos uma liderança técnica hands-on para atuar na arquitetura e evolução de uma plataforma estratégica de autenticação e SSO, em um contexto de crescimento acelerado, e escalabilidade. Essa pessoa terá papel central na construção de uma plataforma para o negócio, influenciando decisões arquiteturais, evolução do codebase, confiabilidade da solução e maturidade técnica do time.

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução da plataforma de IAM / SSO
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura Identity First
  • Atuar como referência técnica na evolução da plataforma de autenticação, identidade e integrações do ecossistema
  • Contribuir hands-on em temas críticos (Keycloak customizado via SPI)
  • Integrar IdPs externos (Google, Microsoft) e sistemas do ecossistema
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, automação e observabilidade

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência com IAM / SSO e protocolos OAuth2, OIDC e SAML
  • Vivência com Keycloak e customizações avançadas
  • Forte base em Java (17+), Kotlin e APIs seguras
  • Experiência em cloud AWS e arquitetura de plataforma

Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fintech | Backend-Focused)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Fintech | Backend-Focused) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are partnering with an innovative international fintech company to hire a Senior Software Engineer to help build the core infrastructure powering private capital markets.


This is a highly strategic engineering role for professionals who enjoy solving complex backend and platform challenges in regulated environments. The company operates at the intersection of fintech, compliance, payments, and transaction infrastructure, building products that support broker-dealer operations, deal management, and payment/escrow workflows.


The ideal candidate combines strong backend engineering expertise with experience building scalable, production-grade systems in financial services, banking, fintech, payments, or other regulated industries.


Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and platform scalability initiatives
  • Develop secure and reliable systems for financial and transaction-related workflows
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across product and engineering
  • Improve system reliability, testing, CI/CD, and deployment processes
  • Participate in technical discussions and mentor other engineers when needed
  • Help evolve a modern engineering culture focused on quality and ownership


Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong backend development expertise with Node.js and TypeScript
  • Experience designing APIs and scalable backend architectures
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, testing, and production deployments
  • Professional English communication skills (written fluency required)
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as fintech, banking, insurance, or payments

    • Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience with fintech, broker-dealer, or financial compliance systems
    • Familiarity with payment processing, escrow systems, reconciliation, or transaction ledgers
    • Knowledge of financial regulatory environments such as FINRA, SEC, BACEN, CVM, PIX, or Open Banking
    • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
    • Experience mentoring junior engineers
    • Exposure to M&A platforms, virtual data rooms (VDR), or capital markets infrastructure


    Tech Stack
    • TypeScript
    • Node.js
    • React
    • Next.js
    • Relational Databases
    • Cloud Infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure)


    Benefits
    • Health Plan (Bradesco)
    • Dental Plan (Bradesco)
    • Meal Allowance (~R$1,000/month)
    • Transportation Allowance


    Additional Information
    • Full-time position
    • International and fast-paced environment
    • Strong opportunity for technical ownership and long-term growth


    If you are passionate about building scalable financial infrastructure and enjoy solving complex backend challenges, we would love to hear from you!

title: Gerente de People
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de People em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Gerente de People , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Estratégia e impacto no negócio:

Definir, evoluir e executar a estratégia de People alinhada aos objetivos da empresa, garantindo que cultura, estrutura organizacional e práticas de gestão sustentem o crescimento do negócio;

  • Escala e eficiência organizacional:

Evoluir e estruturar processos e projetos de People com foco em escalabilidade, padronização e eficiência operacional, garantindo consistência na experiência do colaborador;

  • Parceria com lideranças:

Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das lideranças, apoiando decisões organizacionais, desenvolvimento de times e estruturação da organização;

  • Liderança da área de People:

Liderar e desenvolver o time de People, garantindo alta performance, clareza de papéis e evolução contínua da equipe;

  • Cultura e engajamento:

Fortalecer a cultura organizacional, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho saudável, com alto nível de engajamento e alinhamento aos valores da empresa;

  • People Analytics e dados:

Definir, acompanhar e evoluir indicadores de People, promovendo tomada de decisão baseada em dados e apoiando lideranças com insights estratégicos;

  • Gestão por métricas e resultados:

Apoiar a implementação e acompanhamento de OKRs, garantindo conexão entre estratégia, execução e resultados;

  • Atração e seleção de talentos:

Definir e evoluir estratégias de atração e seleção alinhadas às necessidades do negócio e à cultura organizacional;

  • People Operations e Departamento Pessoal:

Garantir excelência operacional e conformidade nos processos de Departamento Pessoal (folha, admissões, rescisões, benefícios e obrigações legais);

  • Relações internas e clima organizacional:

Atuar na gestão de clima e relações internas, apoiando na resolução de conflitos e promovendo um ambiente colaborativo;

  • Uso de tecnologia e IA em People:

Identificar e implementar oportunidades de uso de tecnologia e IA para otimizar processos, aumentar produtividade e melhorar a tomada de decisão na área.


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia liderando áreas de People em empresas em crescimento;
  • Vivência com múltiplas frentes de People (Business Partner, Cultura, People Ops, Atração & Seleção e Departamento Pessoal);
  • Experiência sólida na estruturação e gestão de projetos e processos de People;
  • Forte experiência com dados, indicadores e People Analytics para tomada de decisão;
  • Conhecimento em OKRs e gestão por métricas;
  • Experiência atuando de forma estratégica com lideranças;
  • Capacidade de liderança, influência e desenvolvimento de times;
  • Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos (startups ou empresas de crescimento acelerado);
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de transitar entre níveis estratégicos e operacionais;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de People, dados ou dashboards.


Diferenciais :

  • Experiência escalando estruturas de People já existentes;
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, logística ou ambientes digitais;
  • Experiência com implementação de People Analytics e/ou cultura data-driven;
  • Experiência com uso de IA e automação em processos de People;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Power BI, Lovable ou similares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

title: Analista de Operações de Dados Senior #1004173
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Operações de Dados Senior #1004173 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Ser responsável por executar o processo mensal de billing, garantindo extração, tratamento e consistência dos dados, com forte atuação em automação de processos e rotinas (especialmente em Excel).


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Executar o ciclo mensal de billing (extração, validação e consolidação de dados);
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em Databricks;
  • Construir e manter queries em SQL para geração de bases de faturamento;
  • Realizar tratamento, limpeza e reconciliação de dados;
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais e controles (principalmente em Excel);
  • Desenvolver e manter planilhas avançadas (macros, VBA, Power Query);
  • Garantir qualidade e integridade dos dados utilizados no billing;
  • Gerar relatórios operacionais de suporte ao faturamento;
  • Interagir com áreas parceiras para ajustes e validações;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de inconsistências.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Excel avançado (VBA, macros, Power Query);
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL;
  • Experiência prática com Databricks;
  • Experiência com automação de processos operacionais;
  • Experiência com manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com billing / faturamento;
  • Conhecimento de processos financeiros;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI ou similar);
  • Noções de Python para automação.


Local de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Senior Workday Financials Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Workday Financials Consultant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the job


As a Senior Workday Financials Consultant at Aspire, you will support the Finance Solution Delivery team in configuring, maintaining, and enhancing Workday Financials. You will work across multiple financial domains, handling both production support and project-based work, while partnering with Finance stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable solutions. This role requires strong autonomy, problem-solving skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, lean team environment.

What you’ll do


  • Provide hands-on configuration, support, and maintenance across multiple Workday Financials domains.
  • Act as a flexible “utility player,” supporting priority areas based on business needs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and system defects in a timely manner.
  • Design and implement scalable Workday Financials solutions aligned with long-term platform health.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into system configurations.
  • Support ongoing enhancements, optimizations, and process improvements within Workday Financials.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of financial system changes.
  • Contribute to backlog reduction and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders.
  • Ensure solutions are well-designed, maintainable, and aligned with best practices.


What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Workday Financials.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday.
  • Experience supporting both production support and project-based implementations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and systems thinking skills.
  • Proven experience across multiple Financials domains, especially: Financial Accounting (top priority), Expenses, Business Assets, Banking & Settlement (secondary)
  • Experience with Workday Accounting Center and/or Prism is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Workday integrations and reporting is a plus.
  • Exposure to Workday Orchestrations or automation frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage directly with business stakeholders.
  • Experience working in lean, high-performing teams with broad ownership responsibilities.

description:

About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)

description:

Position: 

Bilingual Administrative and Client Communication Assistant, Remote 


Job Overview:

We are looking for a Client Support and Administrative Assistant to join our residential cleaning company based in California, USA. This is a long-term, stable remote position, not a temporary project.

Internal communication is in Portuguese, and client communication is in English. This role is a good fit for someone who is still building their professional experience, communicates clearly and professionally in English, enjoys organization, is detail-oriented, and wants stability in a small, well-organized business. 


Working Hours:

The standard schedule is 30 hours per week, Monday through Friday.

Optional: up to 2 Saturdays per month. Saturday availability is not required. 


Two schedule options:

Morning schedule:

Starts at 7:30am Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 11:30 Brazil time. The ideal schedule is 6 hours per day, but the end time can be flexible depending on the candidate’s availability. This means the morning schedule may range from 4.5 to 6 hours per day, Monday through Friday, with compensation adjusted accordingly. 


Afternoon schedule:

12pm to 6pm Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 16:00 to 22:00 Brazil time.


Compensation (paid in Brazilian reais):

  • R$ 3.000 per month for 30 hours per week, plus a performance-based bonus.


Type of contract:

Independent Contractor, Brazilian MEI. 


Requirements:

  • Strong English writing skills are required, since most client communication is handled by email and text. You should also feel comfortable speaking with clients by phone when needed. 
  • Basic Spanish for simple communication with the cleaning team. You do not need to be fluent. 
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace tools, including Docs, Sheets, and Drive. 
  • Ability to follow clear procedures and become more independent with training. 
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection, a high-quality headset with voice isolation, and an interruption-free workspace during working hours. 


Responsibilities:

description:

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning.   • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AI Software Engineer (.NET + Agentic Workflows) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

QAT Global, a 30+ years IT consulting firm headquartered in the US, is seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Software Engineer with strong .NET and Azure expertise and hands-on experience building AI-powered engineering workflows.

This position will work directly with US-based customers and distributed engineering teams across the US, Brazil, and Costa Rica.


About the Role

This is not a traditional backend development role.

You will help design, build, and operate AI-driven engineering workflows that automate software development activities using modern LLMs and agent frameworks. The role combines backend engineering, AI workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, and critical review of AI-generated code.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both software engineering and applied AI domains — building automation while also validating and improving generated outputs.

This is an international environment, and the position is collaborative and technically strong.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain AI-assisted development workflows for .NET applications
  • Build integrations between LLMs, internal tooling, and engineering platforms
  • Create and refine prompts, templates, structured outputs, and agent behaviors
  • Review, validate, and improve AI-generated .NET code and pull requests
  • Develop automation around Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling
  • Build evaluation and verification mechanisms for AI-generated outputs
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to follow enterprise standards and patterns
  • Debug and optimize agent execution flows, tooling integrations, and orchestration logic
  • Contribute to platform reliability, observability, and operational efficiency


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and Entity Framework
  • Strong Azure Cloud experience, including services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Managed Identities, etc.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
  • Ability to read and interpret technical and architectural documentation
  • Hands-on experience working with modern LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, or similar
  • Working proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or AI workflows
  • Experience with prompt engineering and AI workflow design
  • Familiarity with at least one modern AI/agent framework, such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, and similar frameworks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Advanced English communication skills


Nice to Have

  • Experience with developer tooling or engineering automation
  • AI-assisted code generation or PR automation experience
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
  • Observability or evaluation frameworks for AI systems
  • Experience with Blazor or legacy .NET Framework applications
  • Exposure to prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, or LLM testing strategies


What We Are Looking For

We are looking for engineers who:

  • enjoy solving complex technical problems;
  • are comfortable working with emerging AI technologies;
  • can balance engineering quality with experimentation;
  • have a hands-on mindset;
  • can critically evaluate AI-generated outputs rather than blindly trusting them.

  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems

  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

description:

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote SwarmBench Task Engineer - 75063 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)
