title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

DevOps Engineer:


We are looking for a full-time, remote DevOps Engineer with 3 to 5 years of work experience to work with our U.S. client. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing highly secure, scalable, and reliable cloud platform solutions on AWS. You will collaborate with the Head of DevOps and other technical leaders to build and maintain infrastructure, automation, monitoring, and security processes. Additionally, you will play a key role in supporting ISO 27001 / ISMS / SOC2 Type II compliance efforts.


This role requires strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. While an infrastructure background is beneficial, you should also be comfortable writing scripts and basic software code to enhance and streamline operations.


Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, building new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and the Australia / New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with the Head of DevOps to define detailed technical requirements, plan work, and prioritize tasks according to business needs

  • Ensure strict security compliance and best practices in cloud infrastructure
  • Drive automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and system reliability

  • Identify potential failure points in infrastructure and proactively develop mitigation strategies

Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 3 to 5 years of DevOps experience

title: Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).


The Test:

If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Arquiteta de Software .NET em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: .NET, Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Client Support and Administrative Assistant, Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client Support and Administrative Assistant, Remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position: 

Bilingual Administrative and Client Communication Assistant, Remote 


Job Overview:

We are looking for a Client Support and Administrative Assistant to join our residential cleaning company based in California, USA. This is a long-term, stable remote position, not a temporary project.

Internal communication is in Portuguese, and client communication is in English. This role is a good fit for someone who is still building their professional experience, communicates clearly and professionally in English, enjoys organization, is detail-oriented, and wants stability in a small, well-organized business. 


Working Hours:

The standard schedule is 30 hours per week, Monday through Friday.

Optional: up to 2 Saturdays per month. Saturday availability is not required. 


Two schedule options:

Morning schedule:

Starts at 7:30am Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 11:30 Brazil time. The ideal schedule is 6 hours per day, but the end time can be flexible depending on the candidate’s availability. This means the morning schedule may range from 4.5 to 6 hours per day, Monday through Friday, with compensation adjusted accordingly. 


Afternoon schedule:

12pm to 6pm Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 16:00 to 22:00 Brazil time.


Compensation (paid in Brazilian reais):

  • R$ 3.000 per month for 30 hours per week, plus a performance-based bonus.


Type of contract:

Independent Contractor, Brazilian MEI. 


Requirements:

  • Strong English writing skills are required, since most client communication is handled by email and text. You should also feel comfortable speaking with clients by phone when needed. 
  • Basic Spanish for simple communication with the cleaning team. You do not need to be fluent. 
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace tools, including Docs, Sheets, and Drive. 
  • Ability to follow clear procedures and become more independent with training. 
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection, a high-quality headset with voice isolation, and an interruption-free workspace during working hours. 


Responsibilities:

  • Assist clients through email and text, communicating clearly and professionally.
  • The role also includes occasional phone calls in English, mainly to handle initial inquiries, ask screening questions, and share service information. This is not a cold-calling or outbound sales position. 
  • Keep client information, appointments, notes, and related records organized in our scheduling system, Google Docs, Sheets, and Drive. 
  • Communicate with the cleaning team in Spanish for basic day-to-day updates. 


We’re a small, professional, and friendly team, and we’re looking for someone reliable, organized, and consistent. 


To apply:

Please send your resume, your preferred schedule option, and a 1 to 2 minute video in English sharing a little about your professional experience to .

title: Director of Engineering
description:

Director of Engineering (LATAM Based) - Remote - $175K Base


About the Company:


We are partnering with a fast-growing SaaS platform modernizing complex operational workflows for institutional financial services organizations. Their technology helps enterprise clients streamline onboarding, transaction management, compliance workflows, and stakeholder collaboration through a secure cloud-based platform.


The product is used by sophisticated organizations that require reliability, scalability, and high standards for security and operational excellence. They are focused on reducing operational friction and delivering a seamless digital experience in an industry traditionally dependent on manual processes.


The Opportunity:


We are seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead and scale a distributed engineering organization in a high-growth remote environment.


This role will oversee multiple engineering teams and front-line engineering managers across a globally distributed organization. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who excels at building engineering culture, improving operational maturity, and helping teams execute effectively at scale.


You will work closely with executive leadership, product management, and architecture leadership to drive engineering execution, organizational development, and technical excellence.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and mentor engineering managers and technical leaders across multiple teams
  • Build a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement

  • Improve engineering processes, delivery predictability, and development workflows across teams
  • Partner with Product and cross-functional leadership to align technical execution with business priorities
  • Establish engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and platform reliability
  • Support organizational growth by developing future leaders and strengthening management capabilities
  • Drive alignment and communication across distributed engineering teams operating in multiple time zones
  • Help create a high-performing, inclusive, and transparent remote-first environment


Qualifications:


  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with significant engineering leadership responsibility
  • Proven experience managing managers and overseeing multiple engineering teams in a scaling organization
  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern software engineering operations
  • Experience scaling distributed engineering organizations in remote or hybrid environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery execution, and organizational health
  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural and engineering decisions
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and executive leadership


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base salary: $175,000 USD
  • Fully remote - company HQ'd in the US
  • Opportunity to help shape engineering strategy during a high-growth phase

Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM


About the role

AI/R Company is a global ecosystem of technology and innovation that brings together companies specialized in digital transformation, software engineering, data, cloud, and artificial intelligence. The group includes well-known companies in the market such as Avenue Code and Compass UOL, working on strategic projects for major organizations worldwide.

We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in international technical recruiting within IT consulting, strategic mindset, leadership capabilities, and a results-driven approach.

  • Monitor recruitment metrics and continuously improve funnel performance, SLA, conversion rates, and candidate experience

  • Experience recruiting roles such as Software Engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, Cloud, SAP, among others
  • Advanced or fluent English for interviews and meetings
  • Experience with active sourcing and talent attraction strategies
  • Analytical, organized, and metrics-driven profile


Nice to have

  • Experience with LATAM operations expansion

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and compliance with the most rigorous data protection regulations worldwide, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. Candidates’ data will be kept confidential and used exclusively for recruitment purposes and may be shared with clients and companies within the Compass UOL Group involved in projects.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

A Conface Contabilidade , empresa da Dreamland Holding (que também inclui a Dream Success), está em busca de um(a) Analista Contábil Fiscal Jr. para integrar o time.


Essa é uma oportunidade para contadores que desejam crescer em uma contabilidade reconhecida pelo modelo inovador e por um atendimento verdadeiramente humanizado .


Para nós, contabilidade não é apenas enviar tributos para o cliente todos os meses. É fazer parte da vida do empreendedor , ajudando-o a crescer e tomar decisões estratégicas.


Responsabilidades (Fiscal & Contábil)


  • Apuração de impostos : ISS, ICMS, IPI, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS.
  • Obrigações acessórias : EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, ECD , ECF, DCTF, EFD-Reinf e DEFIS (e DIRF quando exigida pela legislação vigente).
  • Acompanhamento das mudanças do IVA (Imposto sobre Valor Adicionado) que passam a vigorar a partir do próximo ano.
  • Fechamento contábil autônomo : conciliações, provisões, classificação contábil, balancetes, Balanço e DRE .
  • Relatórios gerenciais e indicadores das empresas da carteira.
  • Atendimento consultivo a clientes para dúvidas técnicas (fiscal e contábil).
  • Demais atividades inerentes ao cargo.


Requisitos


  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (concluída ou em andamento).
  • CRC ativo (obrigatório e deve constar no currículo enviado para conferência ).
  • Experiência anterior na função fiscal/contábil em escritório de contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento de Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional .
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Excel ).
  • Sistema Domínio : conhecimento prático e comprovado (eliminatório).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto.


Nossa cultura


Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega .

Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados , mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento .


Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”.

Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho , onde quem se dedica, cresce.


Benefícios


  • Vaga 100% remota — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto.
  • Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é ️‍ . Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
  • Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.
  • Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses , conforme seu desempenho.
  • Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$600 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
  • Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa.
  • Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário.


Como se candidatar


  • Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado , mandatóriamente em PDF.
  • É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.
  • Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).
  • Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Abril/26.


Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

description:

Hr Path Group

O Grupo HR Path, um interveniente global na consultoria de RH, acompanha os seus clientes nos seus projetos de transformação de RH, tanto nos aspectos humanos como nas ferramentas (HRIS). Intervimos na Europa, América e Ásia-Pacífico, para as nossas grandes contas e clientes PME, a fim de lhes oferecer um apoio global no desenvolvimento da sua estratégia de RH.

Aconselhar para executar! HR Path, líder mundial em soluções de RH

Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados (ingestão, transformação e entrega) nas camadas Landing, Raw, Silver e Gold do Data Lakehouse em Microsoft Fabric

• Construir e Sustentar dashboards e relatórios em Power BI para suporte a decisões de clientes e áreas internas

• Automatizar e integrar fluxos e processos com N8N (low-code/code), conectando APIs, sistemas de RH e fontes de dados diversas

• Garantir a qualidade, rastreabilidade e documentação dos dados produzidos pela equipe

• Colaborar com o time de Analytics & AI em iniciativas de IA generativa e projetos de analytics avançado

• Apoiar a evolução da arquitetura de dados e propor melhorias de performance e governança


Requisitos Técnicos:

Conhecimento

• Power BI: criação de relatórios, modelagem de dados, DAX e publicação de dashboards

• N8N: construção de workflows de automação e integração de sistemas via API

• Stack Microsoft: familiaridade com o ecossistema Azure / Microsoft 365

• SQL: consultas, transformações e modelagem relacional Diferencial

• Microsoft Fabric: Lakehouse, Data Pipeline, SQL Endpoint

• Python: scripts de ingestão, transformação ou automação

• Databricks / PySpark: processamento em larga escala

• Conhecimento em SAP SuccessFactors ou outros sistemas de RH


Perfil Comportamental:

• Curiosidade genuína: busca entender como as coisas funcionam e resolve problemas de forma autônoma

• Orientação a desafios: enxerga problemas difíceis como oportunidades de crescimento

• Vontade de crescer: quer construir carreira sólida em dados e AI, com pressa para aprender

• Proatividade: identifica oportunidades de melhoria e age sem esperar ser mandado

• Colaboração: trabalha bem em equipe, compartilha conhecimento e se comunica com clareza

• Organização e autonomia: entrega com consistência mesmo em modelo predominantemente remoto


Nosso jeito de trabalhar:

• Modelo de trabalho flexível: 4 dias home office + 1 dia presencial por semana

• Ambiente colaborativo e sem burocracia excessiva — sua voz tem peso

• Exposição a projetos reais com clientes de grande porte em escala global (28 países)

• Contato direto com tecnologias de ponta: Fabric, Databricks, N8N e IA generativa

• Time técnico experiente e comprometido com o seu desenvolvimento

• Oportunidade concreta de crescimento dentro da área e da empresa


O que oferecemos:

  • Um ambiente de trabalho estimulante no seio de uma cultura empreendedora e internacional
  • Uma abordagem transversal das nossas atividades, que favorece o trabalho em equipe e a excelência
  • Numerosas oportunidades de progressão (mobilidade horizontal, vertical e internacional)
  • Múltiplas oportunidades de formação (universidade interna, certificações)
  • Certificado Happy at Work, oferecemos um bom equilíbrio de vida com possibilidades de teletrabalho
  • Um ambiente de trabalho amigável (atividades de equipe trimestrais, seminário internacional anual)


Nos vemos em breve na HR Path!

title: Engenheiro de Dados #1004191
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados #1004191 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Precisamos de um(a) Data Engineer para atuar no time de Finance Transformation , apoiando iniciativas de dados relacionadas a processos financeiros, com foco em billing, faturamento, faturas, cobranças, conciliação e indicadores financeiros .

A pessoa deverá atuar na construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados em ambiente Databricks/Lakehouse , garantindo ingestão, transformação, qualidade e disponibilização dos dados para consumo analítico e camada semântica. Também deverá apoiar a preparação de bases e datasets para consumo em Power BI .


Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e hands-on, com boa comunicação para interagir com times de negócio e tecnologia. É importante que tenha visão ponta a ponta dos dados, capacidade de entender regras financeiras e transformá-las em pipelines, modelos e indicadores confiáveis.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

• Desenvolver pipelines de ingestão, tratamento e transformação de dados usando Databricks, Spark/PySpark e SQL.

• Trabalhar com dados de billing, faturas, transações, cobranças, pagamentos, ajustes, estornos e conciliações.

• Garantir consistência dos dados entre camadas de ingestão, preparação, refinamento e consumo.

• Apoiar a criação de datasets, modelos analíticos e indicadores para Power BI.

• Implementar validações de qualidade, reconciliação e rastreabilidade dos dados.

• Documentar fluxos, regras de transformação, dicionário de dados e mapeamentos.

• Interagir com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e finanças.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência sólida como Data Engineer.

• Experiência prática com Databricks, Spark/PySpark e SQL.

• Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lake/Lakehouse.

• Experiência com Power BI, especialmente preparação de datasets/modelos para consumo analítico.

• Conhecimento de processos financeiros: billing, faturamento, cobrança, contas a receber, conciliação ou pagamentos.

• Experiência com cloud, preferencialmente Azure.

• Conhecimento de governança, qualidade, linhagem e documentação de dados.


Diferenciais

• Experiência em bancos, meios de pagamento, adquirência, fintechs ou ambientes regulados.

• Conhecimento em camada semântica, produtos de dados ou governança corporativa.

• Experiência com Jira, Confluence, Azure Data Factory, Purview ou OpenMetadata.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Python Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

title: Fractional Account Manager — Partnerships & Growth
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fractional Account Manager — Partnerships & Growth em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hi,

Fractional Account Manager — Partnerships & Growth

Remote Part-Time (Fractional)

Full Time

Why this role exists

Millions of people in the US rely on self-pay healthcare. They face high costs, limited access, and poor transparency.

We are building a membership-based platform that delivers affordable access to care, including primary care, labs, imaging, and prescriptions. Our infrastructure is in place. Growth now depends on strong partner execution and account management.

This role ensures partners succeed, grow, and stay engaged.

The opportunity

This is an ownership-driven account management role.

You will manage and grow key distribution channels, including healthcare brokers, affinity partners, and employer networks. You will focus on partner performance, retention, and expansion.

You will work closely with leadership to strengthen relationships, improve partner output, and drive consistent growth.

What you’ll own

• Manage and grow broker and partner relationships

• Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts

• Support partners with onboarding, training, and ongoing enablement

• Track partner performance and identify growth opportunities

• Work with channel partners to follow up and close their leads

• Ensure high partner engagement and retention

• Maintain pipeline visibility and reporting discipline

• Coordinate with internal teams to resolve partner issues quickly

• Improve processes that drive partner success and scalability

What you’ll drive

• Account growth across existing partners

• Higher partner conversion rates

• Strong retention and repeat engagement

• Consistent communication cadence with partners

• Clear reporting on account health and performance

Who we’re looking for

• 1-3 years of experience in account management, partnerships, or healthcare sales

• Experience working with brokers, employers, or channel partners

• Strong relationship management and communication skills

• Ability to manage multiple accounts with clear prioritization

• Experience working remotely with high ownership and discipline

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, early-stage environment

• Mission-driven mindset around improving healthcare access

Strongly preferred

• Experience in healthcare, benefits, or insurance distribution

• Exposure to broker-driven sales models

• Experience in ICHRA or small employer benefits

• Existing relationships with brokers or channel partners

description:

As a Sr. Claude Developer, you are responsible for delivering high‑impact features in a fast‑moving, AI‑assisted development environment. You are deeply experienced in AI‑driven and agentic development workflows, using tools such as Claude and/or Cursor to significantly increase development speed, quality, and iteration velocity. You are comfortable with vibe coding, working fluidly with AI to explore solutions, refine implementations, and ship results quickly. You thrive in sprint‑based teams with clear deadlines, take ownership of complex workstreams, and consistently perform at a high output level. You are comfortable collaborating with distributed teams and ramping quickly on new codebases, tooling, and workflows.


Sr. Claude Developer | Day-to-Day

  • Build, refactor, and deliver production‑ready features using TypeScript in a modern application stack.
  • Leverage advanced AI coding tools (Claude and/or Cursor) as a core part of your daily development workflow, including agentic and iterative coding patterns.

  • Collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical leadership to solve complex technical problems.
  • Review and improve existing code while maintaining performance, readability, and scalability.

  • Recent, dedicated experience using Claude and/or Cursor at an advanced level, leveraging these tools for high‑velocity, high‑quality development beyond basic code generation.

Somos uma startup fundada em Dezembro de 2018, que oferece uma plataforma de gestão de entregas rápidas / delivery. title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Python Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

title: Engenheiro de software
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de software em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Engenheiro de software


Descrição:


-Projetar, implementar e entregar funcionalidades complexas em componentes grandes ou aplicações de médio porte do design ao deploy;

-Experiência sólida com React/TypeScript no frontend, e Python/FastAPI no backend;

-Experiência com Azure Database, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, PostgreSQL e modelagem de dados relacional;

-Atuação com pgvector ou bancos vetoriais;

-Forte Domínio prático com Clean Code, SOLID, YAGNI, TDD, BDD e 12-Factor App;

-Experiência com Microsoft Azure, GitHub Actions, Claude Code e práticas de CI/CD;

-Experiência com Segurança e governança: Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault e Microsoft Purview;

-Proficiência em uma ampla gama de design patterns e estruturas de dados;

-Experiência com observabilidade (logs, métricas e tracing);

- Escrever código limpo, seguro, estável e testável que qualquer engenheiro do time consiga entender e resolver problemas técnicos difíceis com soluções pragmáticas;

-Testar código com rigor: testes unitários, de integração e de contrato (não são etapas separadas);

- Documentar o software com clareza: decisões arquiteturais, intenções de design e contratos entre componentes;


Diferencial:

-Conhecimento em integração de APIs de IA (Claude API, OpenAI) e construção de features com LLMs;

-Familiaridade com Azure API Management, Azure Event Grid ou event-driven architecture;

-Experiência com compliance (LGPD);

-Vivência em ambientes de alto crescimento ou startups com times enxutos e alta cadência de entrega;

-Contribuições em projetos open source ou portfólio técnico público;


Atuação Home Office

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

Auxílio creche;

Convênio com Farmácia;

Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

WellHub;

Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Cloud Architect Especialista para atuar em um time estratégico de alta maturidade técnica, com foco em modernização de aplicações, infraestrutura em nuvem AWS e práticas avançadas de DevOps.

Esse profissional será referência técnica, apoiando decisões arquiteturais complexas, definindo padrões, garantindo governança e assegurando a adoção das melhores práticas do AWS Well-Architected Framework em soluções de missão crítica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura em nuvem AWS;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenho, validação e evolução de arquiteturas em nuvem escaláveis, seguras, resilientes e eficientes;
  • Desenvolver soluções, modelos de referência, frameworks e ferramentas para a plataforma AWS;
  • Provisionar, configurar e gerenciar infraestrutura em AWS, garantindo padrões de segurança, performance e custo;
  • Definir e implementar pipelines de automação utilizando Infrastructure as Code (IaC) com Terraform, AWS CloudFormation e AWS CDK (Python);
  • Estruturar, evoluir e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD para deploy de aplicações, agentes e ferramentas;
  • Garantir conformidade das soluções com o AWS Well-Architected Framework;
  • Atuar no levantamento de requisitos técnicos e não técnicos, apoiando decisões estratégicas de arquitetura;
  • Definir e disseminar boas práticas de arquitetura, infraestrutura, segurança, governança e observabilidade;
  • Promover compartilhamento de conhecimento, mentoria técnica e apoio à evolução do time.


Requisitos e qualificações obrigatórios


  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de atuação comprovada em CTPS;
  • Experiência sólida e aprofundada com AWS;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS CDK (Python), AWS CloudFormation e Terraform;
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, definição e desenho arquitetural, provisionamento, configuração e desenvolvimento de recursos AWS;
  • Experiência na estruturação e evolução de esteiras CI/CD, containers, Git, boas práticas DevOps e padrões de segurança;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação técnica para interação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.


Habilidades comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara, estratégica e assertiva;
  • Capacidade de conduzir discussões técnicas complexas e negociações arquiteturais;
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico;
  • Perfil de referência técnica, com atuação consultiva e de mentoria;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Forte orientação à qualidade, eficiência e resultados;
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão em ambientes complexos.



Sobre a empresa


Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced technologies.

We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technologies.

We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

title: Gestor(a) de Contas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gestor(a) de Contas em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Gestor(a) de Contas – Marketplace & Performance

Somos uma empresa especializada em estratégia, operação e crescimento de e-commerces e marketplaces , com forte atuação orientada a dados, tecnologia e performance .

Buscamos um(a) Gestor(a) de Contas para atuar de forma estratégica, sendo responsável pela operação e pelos resultados dos clientes .

Essa posição exige visão analítica, senso de dono e capacidade de integrar estoque, tráfego, campanhas e performance comercial em diferentes marketplaces.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como responsável direto(a) pela performance dos clientes, sendo o ponto focal da conta
  • Monitorar e garantir SLA dos marketplaces, antecipando riscos e oportunidades
  • Acompanhar estoque no Centro de Distribuição e realizar solicitações de abastecimento para venda direta
  • Definir e acompanhar a estratégia de venda entre marketplaces (onde vender, quando e como)
  • Gerenciar campanhas ativas, mix de produtos e visibilidade nos marketplaces
  • Analisar dados de tráfego, estoque e conversão, propondo ações contínuas de crescimento
  • Atuar de forma próxima a clientes e lideranças, com comunicação clara, estratégica e orientada a resultados
  • Evoluir, em até 6 meses, para autonomia total na gestão da performance, regras de tráfego e decisões de estoque


Requisitos

  • Experiência com marketplaces e e-commerce, especialmente em gestão operacional e performance
  • Excel intermediário
  • Forte senso de dono, responsabilidade e visão de negócio
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com dados, indicadores e métricas
  • Afinidade com tecnologia e ferramentas digitais
  • Capacidade de navegação e análise em painéis de marketplace (ex.: Mercado Livre)
  • Boa comunicação para interação com clientes e lideranças


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com gestão de múltiplas contas ou operações simultâneas
  • Perfil analítico, investigativo e orientado à melhoria contínua
  • Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos e com alta exigência por resultados


O que oferecemos

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Remuneração variável trimestral , vinculada ao alcance de metas e resultados
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e impacto direto no negócio


Modelo de trabalho

  • 100% remoto (Home Office)
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial no Centro de Distribuição no litoral de São Paulo , quando necessário.

title: Analista de Operações de Dados Senior #1004173
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Operações de Dados Senior #1004173 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Ser responsável por executar o processo mensal de billing, garantindo extração, tratamento e consistência dos dados, com forte atuação em automação de processos e rotinas (especialmente em Excel).


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Executar o ciclo mensal de billing (extração, validação e consolidação de dados);
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em Databricks;
  • Construir e manter queries em SQL para geração de bases de faturamento;
  • Realizar tratamento, limpeza e reconciliação de dados;
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais e controles (principalmente em Excel);
  • Desenvolver e manter planilhas avançadas (macros, VBA, Power Query);
  • Garantir qualidade e integridade dos dados utilizados no billing;
  • Gerar relatórios operacionais de suporte ao faturamento;
  • Interagir com áreas parceiras para ajustes e validações;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de inconsistências.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Excel avançado (VBA, macros, Power Query);
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL;
  • Experiência prática com Databricks;
  • Experiência com automação de processos operacionais;
  • Experiência com manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com billing / faturamento;
  • Conhecimento de processos financeiros;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI ou similar);
  • Noções de Python para automação.


Local de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Assistente de operações
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente de operações em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Assistente de Operações — Turismo de Luxo Part-time · Remoto · PJ · R$ 4.000/mês


Sobre a Bici Trip Somos uma empresa brasileira especializada em tours de cicloturismo de luxo pela Europa. Levamos grupos pequenos — até 14 pessoas — por rotas desenhadas na França, Itália, Portugal, Espanha, Alemanha e Holanda. Hotéis de luxo, restaurantes selecionados, e-bikes de qualidade e guias experientes. Tudo incluso, nada improvisado.


Contexto da vaga Com 28 tours em 2026 e 32 em 2027, nossa operação cresceu e o volume de trabalho exige reforço. Buscamos alguém no Brasil para trabalhar de forma assíncrona com nosso time na Europa — organizando, consolidando e garantindo que nada escape entre reservas, fornecedores e clientes.


Responsabilidades

Hotéis & fornecedores

— Envio de rooming lists — Organização de invoices para o financeiro — Controle de prazos de devolução de quartos — Acompanhamento de pagamentos


Restaurantes

— Apoio em reservas e confirmações — Envio de restrições alimentares — Organização de menus pré-selecionados — Registro de histórico por restaurante


Equipe de guias

— Reserva de voos e trens — Reserva de acomodações para a equipe — Logística de dias de transição


Clientes & atividades

— Verificação de pedidos especiais — Reserva de atividades e traslados — Apoio à equipe durante os tours


Consolidação no Notion

— Manutenção do roadbook de cada tour — Apoio na criação do day by day — Organização de informações por etapa


Perfil buscado — Formação em turismo, eventos, hospitalidade, produção ou área correlata

— Inglês fluente (obrigatório) · Italiano ou francês são diferenciais

— Familiaridade com Notion ou ferramentas similares

— Organizado(a), atento(a) a detalhes e confortável com trabalho assíncrono

— Interesse genuíno por viagens, gastronomia e experiências de alto padrão


O que oferecemos — R$ 4.000/mês (PJ) — 4h por dia, horário flexível — 100% remoto, do Brasil — Contato direto com uma operação de turismo de alto padrão

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

title: Desenvolvedor júnior

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:

  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento de código e práticas CI/CD (Git);
