  • Conhecimento de base de dados (SQL, noSql);
  • Proficiência na qualidade das entregas e do funcionamento das soluções desenvolvidas como um todo.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento de arquitetura baseada a eventos, e serviços de mensageria;
  • Conhecimento de Docker e containers;
  • Conhecimento do espanhol;
  • Conhecimento em análise e aperfeiçoamento de performance de APIs;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;

  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;

  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;

Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

description:

Responsabilidades e Atividades

• Realizar análise de custos em ambiente Cloud Azure.

• Atuar na gestão e alocação de custos Cloud.

• Criar previsões, tendências e planejamento financeiro relacionados ao consumo Cloud.

• Apoiar times de Engenharia, Projetos e Produtos na gestão financeira de recursos Azure.

• Atuar com governança e compliance financeiro em nuvem.

• Criar dashboards, relatórios e visualizações de dados para acompanhamento financeiro.

• Realizar análises detalhadas por serviço, região, produto, equipe ou centro de custo, mantendo rotinas contínuas de monitoramento de custos.

• Estruturar e manter modelos de rateio, garantindo associação correta de custos via tags, grupos de recursos e estruturas financeiras.

• Revisar taxonomias e sugerir melhorias de governança.

• Participar de reuniões de revisão de custos Azure com times de operações e liderança.

• Participar de comitês FinOps, governança e gestão orçamentária.

• Mapear oportunidades de savings para construção de planos financeiros anuais.

• Criar previsões de uso e gastos utilizando dados históricos, identificando tendências e sazonalidade de consumo.

• Avaliar impacto financeiro de novos projetos ou workloads e apoiar análises de ROI de iniciativas Cloud.

• Garantir aderência às políticas de tagging e governança de recursos.

• Construir dashboards, alertas e indicadores automatizados para acompanhamento técnico e financeiro.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em Microsoft Azure, incluindo infraestrutura, serviços e tecnologias da plataforma.

• Experiência com Governança em Azure, contemplando:

  • Azure Cost Management
  • Azure Advisor
  • Azure Reservations
  • Azure Policies

• Conhecimento em estruturas de gerenciamento de recursos e organização de ambientes em nuvem:

  • Management Groups
  • Accounts/Subscriptions
  • Billing Groups

• Vivência em práticas de FinOps, incluindo:

  • Princípios da FinOps Foundation
  • Modelos de Showback e Chargeback
  • Alocação e rateio de custos em nuvem
  • Controle orçamentário e elaboração de forecast
  • Análise de custos por unidade de negócio, produto ou centro de custo
  • Interpretação de relatórios financeiros e operacionais

• Conhecimento em políticas de tagging, padronização e taxonomia Cloud.

• Experiência na criação de dashboards, relatórios gerenciais e visualização de dados.

• Certificações Microsoft Azure e/ou FinOps serão consideradas diferenciais.

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

• Realizar análise de custos em ambiente Cloud Azure.

• Atuar na gestão e alocação de custos Cloud.

• Criar previsões, tendências e planejamento financeiro relacionados ao consumo Cloud.

• Apoiar times de Engenharia, Projetos e Produtos na gestão financeira de recursos Azure.

• Criar dashboards, relatórios e visualizações de dados para acompanhamento financeiro.

• Garantir aderência às políticas de tagging e governança de recursos.

• Construir dashboards, alertas e indicadores automatizados para acompanhamento técnico e financeiro.

  • Azure Cost Management
  • Azure Advisor
  • Azure Reservations
  • Azure Policies

• Conhecimento em estruturas de gerenciamento de recursos e organização de ambientes em nuvem:

  • Management Groups
  • Accounts/Subscriptions
  • Billing Groups

• Vivência em práticas de FinOps, incluindo:

  • Princípios da FinOps Foundation
  • Modelos de Showback e Chargeback
  • Alocação e rateio de custos em nuvem
  • Controle orçamentário e elaboração de forecast
  • Análise de custos por unidade de negócio, produto ou centro de custo
  • Interpretação de relatórios financeiros e operacionais

• Conhecimento em políticas de tagging, padronização e taxonomia Cloud.

• Experiência na criação de dashboards, relatórios gerenciais e visualização de dados.

• Certificações Microsoft Azure e/ou FinOps serão consideradas diferenciais.

title: Maintenance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Maintenance Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Morgan Latif is an executive search and development consultancy focused on outcome-driven leadership hiring.


We partner with organisations across Medical Technology & Healthcare, Packaging, Chemicals & Speciality Materials, Consumer, and Industrial Technology to secure leaders who create measurable impact and long-term business performance.


Through deep sector expertise, rigorous assessment, and alignment to business objectives, we identify individuals who not only fit the role, but perform strongly and thrive within the organisation.


Job Title: Maintenance Manager

Company: Multi-national Mood Manufacturer


Position is based in Valencia, Spain and relocation would be supported should your application be successful.


We are working with a fast paced, Private-Equity backed, Food Manufacturing business who is seeking someone with a strong drive for process optimization , CMMS implementation , and leading a maintenance team of approximately 20 people .


The role will involve leading and coordinating maintenance activities for a 24/7 continuous-process plant , managing and optimizing maintenance for process equipment, and driving the transition from reactive to proactive, reliability-based maintenance , including preventative and predictive strategies.


Fluency in both English and Spanish is essential for this role.


Candidate Profile:

  • Fluent English & Spanish speaker
  • Strong experience in process industries (mandatory), such as food, or paper manufacturing.
  • Proven background in reliability-focused maintenance within environments where maintenance strategies are already mature.
  • Ability to implement and sustain best practices in preventive and predictive maintenance.
  • High level of safety awareness, especially in energy-intensive and high-risk environments.
  • High level of Quality awareness linked with Food industry
  • Strong leadership and soft skills to drive cultural change and build trust and accountability.
  • Experience managing complex maintenance organizations and driving data-driven decision-making.
  • Comfortable working with new equipment and establishing KPIs (e.g., MTBF still to be defined due to new machinery).


KPI:

  • Asset reliability / up time (OEE improvement)
  • Reduction of unplanned downtime
  • Preventive vs reactive maintenance ratio
  • Safety, food safety & compliance
  • Maintenance cost vs downtime cost optimization


If you feel up to for a challenge and thrive in a dynamic environment, we look forward to receiving your application!

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Evaluation Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

description:

About FirstIgnite

Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.

  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine).   • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Coordinator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an experienced Social Media Coordinator to join our global team on a six-month contract, with the potential to extend. This is a hands-on execution role for someone who already knows social media.


You will work closely with their Senior Specialists and Senior Manager, taking ownership of mid-tier campaign coordination, skilled content support, and reporting and analytics. Strong English writing skills and a confident grasp of LinkedIn content are essential — as is the ability to exercise content judgement independently.


You will be able to confidently use AI to support efficiency but have good judgment and attention to detail to ensure outputs are accurate and effective.


Please note: This is a contract role through the end of the year (December 31).


Key Responsibilities:

Skilled Content Support

  • Select assets for posts across mid-tier campaigns, applying content judgment and brand standards
  • Write captions for quick-turn posts and one-off content requests, in line with brand tone and best practices
  • Ensure posts align with brand guidelines before publishing
  • Support with Elevate (employee advocacy platform) requests, including self-serve rollout


Campaign Coordination

  • Own coordination of campaigns end-to-end
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders to manage timelines, approvals, and content plans
  • Manage campaign tracking and visibility for assigned workstreams


Reporting and Analytics

  • Build and maintain dashboards and data collection frameworks for monthly, quarterly, and annual reports
  • Produce campaign reports


Publishing and Content Calendar

  • Upload and schedule some content in Sprinklr, ensuring correct tagging and visibility


What We're Looking For:

Essential

  • Minimum 3 years of social media experience, with a strong LinkedIn track record — social content creation experience is essential
  • Excellent written English — you can write clean, on-brand captions and coordinate across multiple stakeholders without heavy oversight
  • Strong content judgement — you can select assets and write for social independently, and know what good looks like on LinkedIn
  • Proven experience managing content calendars and coordinating with multiple teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable with reporting: you can pull data, build dashboards, and present findings clearly
  • Experience with social media publishing tools (Sprinklr or similar)
  • Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities with minimal direction


Preferred

  • Experience coordinating social media for a B2B, professional services, or large corporate brand
  • Familiarity with employee advocacy platforms
  • Experience producing or supporting reporting outputs for senior stakeholders
  • Proficiency with MS Office and digital collaboration tools (Teams, Zoom)
  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT)
  • What to Expect
  • This is a high-output, fast-paced role. You will be working across multiple campaigns simultaneously, with stakeholders in different time zones. You will have clear ownership of your workstreams and work within the wider Social Media team.
  • This is not a role for someone learning the basics of social media. It is an opportunity for an experienced social media professional to make an immediate impact, deliver quality work, and develop deeper expertise within a high-performing global team.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead and coordinate impactful LinkedIn and B2B social media campaigns for a global organization.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Kotlin Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Java/Kotlin Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior com sólido domínio em ecossistema Java e Kotlin para atuar diretamente na sustentação e evolução de nossas aplicações. O papel exige um profissional capaz de transitar entre o backend (Spring Boot) e tecnologias de frontend legadas e modernas, garantindo a estabilidade do ambiente e a resolução eficiente de problemas complexos em produção. O escopo envolve desde a manutenção de bancos de dados com PostgreSQL e Liquibase até o suporte especializado em ambiente Linux, demandando uma visão técnica consultiva para garantir a continuidade do dia a dia operacional.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Atuar no suporte especializado para solução de problemas técnicos em aplicações existentes.
  • Manter e evoluir sistemas desenvolvidos em Java e Kotlin.
  • Realizar manutenções preventivas e corretivas nas aplicações do dia a dia.
  • Utilizar conhecimentos em Linux e ferramentas de versionamento para garantir a integridade dos deploys.
  • Apoiar na manutenção de bancos de dados utilizando PostgreSQL e controle de versão via Liquibase.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência comprovada de 5+ anos no desenvolvimento de softwares.
  • Domínio em Java e Kotlin.
  • Experiência sólida com Spring Boot e JPA.
  • Conhecimentos em frontend: JavaScript, JQuery e JSTL.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados PostgreSQL e ferramenta Liquibase.
  • Vivência com Git/GitHub e comandos básicos de Linux.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação e proatividade.
  • Capacidade de priorização, gestão de multitarefas e foco em resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em times de sustentação ou suporte de terceiro nível.
  • Conhecimento profundo em otimização de queries e performance.


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento web para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Multidisciplinary Creative em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between.
  • Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality.
  • Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces.
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution.
  • Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines.
  • Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them.
  • A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva.
  • Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.).
  • A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience.
  • Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing.
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: Analista de Governança PL – SAP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Governança PL – SAP em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos por um(a) Data Migration Governance Analyst – SAP S/4HANA, para atuar de forma remota em um programa global de transformação SAP S/4HANA, sendo responsável por garantir a governança, rastreabilidade, conformidade e qualidade do processo de migração de dados.

Essa posição terá forte atuação na revisão de evidências, validação documental, conformidade de processos e acompanhamento das etapas de migração de dados em ambiente corporativo global, atuando em conjunto com times técnicos, Data Owners, PMO, Governança e stakeholders internacionais.


RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Revisar criticamente documentações e evidências de migração de dados (dados mestres e transacionais), garantindo aderência aos padrões definidos pelo programa;

• Validar etapas obrigatórias do processo de migração, como extração, pré-load, load, reconciliação e validação pós-load;

• Garantir conformidade com templates, checklists, políticas e processos de governança;

• Avaliar qualidade e rastreabilidade das evidências sob a ótica de auditoria interna e externa;

• Identificar gaps, inconsistências, riscos e pontos de não conformidade;

• Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas, governança, PMO e Data Owners;

• Acompanhar pendências, aprovações e status por país, release e objeto migrado;

• Garantir organização e rastreabilidade das informações em ferramentas como Azure DevOps e SharePoint;

• Apoiar a preparação de pacotes de evidências para auditoria;

• Contribuir com melhorias contínuas em processos, templates, controles e governança.


HABILIDADES E EXPERIÊNCIAS ESSENCIAIS:

• Experiência com governança, auditoria, compliance, controles internos ou conformidade em ambientes corporativos;

• Conhecimento em Lei Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX);

• Conhecimento em metodologia COSO;

• Experiência com análise documental, rastreabilidade e validação de evidências;

• Vivência em projetos de transformação, ERP, migração de dados ou governança de dados;

• Experiência prévia com SAP, especialmente em contextos relacionados à migração, Master Data, governança ou SAP MDG;

• Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação em ambiente global;

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com múltiplos stakeholders;

title: Editor de Vídeo e Imagens (CLT/6h) | Remoto

title: Analista de Governança PL – SAP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Governança PL – SAP em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos por um(a) Data Migration Governance Analyst – SAP S/4HANA, para atuar de forma remota em um programa global de transformação SAP S/4HANA, sendo responsável por garantir a governança, rastreabilidade, conformidade e qualidade do processo de migração de dados.

Essa posição terá forte atuação na revisão de evidências, validação documental, conformidade de processos e acompanhamento das etapas de migração de dados em ambiente corporativo global, atuando em conjunto com times técnicos, Data Owners, PMO, Governança e stakeholders internacionais.


RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Revisar criticamente documentações e evidências de migração de dados (dados mestres e transacionais), garantindo aderência aos padrões definidos pelo programa;

• Validar etapas obrigatórias do processo de migração, como extração, pré-load, load, reconciliação e validação pós-load;

• Garantir conformidade com templates, checklists, políticas e processos de governança;

• Avaliar qualidade e rastreabilidade das evidências sob a ótica de auditoria interna e externa;

• Identificar gaps, inconsistências, riscos e pontos de não conformidade;

• Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas, governança, PMO e Data Owners;

• Acompanhar pendências, aprovações e status por país, release e objeto migrado;

• Garantir organização e rastreabilidade das informações em ferramentas como Azure DevOps e SharePoint;

• Apoiar a preparação de pacotes de evidências para auditoria;

• Contribuir com melhorias contínuas em processos, templates, controles e governança.


HABILIDADES E EXPERIÊNCIAS ESSENCIAIS:

• Experiência com governança, auditoria, compliance, controles internos ou conformidade em ambientes corporativos;

• Conhecimento em Lei Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX);

• Conhecimento em metodologia COSO;

• Experiência com análise documental, rastreabilidade e validação de evidências;

• Vivência em projetos de transformação, ERP, migração de dados ou governança de dados;

• Experiência prévia com SAP, especialmente em contextos relacionados à migração, Master Data, governança ou SAP MDG;

• Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação em ambiente global;

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com múltiplos stakeholders;

title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Engenheiro de Software (Java) - Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Software (Java) - Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in retail.


Key Responsibilities


  • Collaborates and pairs with other product team members (UX, engineering, and product management) to create secure, reliable, scalable software solutions
  • Writes custom code or scripts to automate infrastructure, monitoring services, and test cases
  • Writes custom code or scripts to do \"destructive testing\" to ensure adequate resiliency in production
  • Creates meaningful dashboards, logging, alerting, and responses to ensure that issues are captured and addressed proactively
  • Contributes to enterprise-wide tools to drive destructive testing, automation, or engineering empowerment
  • Identifies product enhancements (client-facing or technical) to create a better experience for the end users
  • Identifies unsecured code areas and implements fixes as they are discovered with or without tooling
  • Contributes to foundational code elements that can be reused many times by a product
  • Contributes to meaningful architecture diagrams and other documentation needed for security reviews or other interested parties
  • Defines Service Level Objectives for product(s) to constantly measure their reliability in production and help prioritize backlog work



Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience with Java 11 or above
  • Experience and understanding of what Lambda Expressions and Streams are in Java 8
  • SQL experience (BigQuery)
  • Understanding of ML concepts
  • Experience using Spring Boot
  • Must have experience developing microservices with Spring Boot
  • Experience developing applications that are hosted in the cloud – client uses GPC, but open to AWS or Azure experience
  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience writing Junit test cases
  • 2+ years’ experience working in an Agile environment in 2 week sprints
  • Advanced English required



Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• CLT hiring model + benefits

• International team environment

title: Cold-Caller (Brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cold-Caller (Brasil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're a UK-based marketing agency that works exclusively with aesthetics clinics and training academies. We help them get more clients and course bookings through paid ads and a done-for-you lead generation system.


We're growing and looking for a part-time SDR based in Brazil to join the team remotely.


Let's be honest about what this is: This is a pure sales role at a fast-moving start-up. You'll be cold calling UK businesses, handling objections, getting hung up on, and coming back for more. If that sounds terrifying, this isn't for you. If that sounds like a challenge, keep reading.


What you'll be doing:

  • Cold calling and DM outreach to aesthetics clinic owners and training academies in the UK
  • Booking discovery calls for our director to close
  • Managing prospects in our CRM (GoHighLevel)
  • Following up consistently and professionally


What we're looking for:

  • Based in Brazil: non-negotiable
  • Fluent English: you'll be calling UK businesses daily
  • Thick skin: rejection is part of the job and you know that
  • Hungry: you want commission, you want to grow, you want to win
  • Self-starter: no one will babysit you, you manage your own time and hit your numbers
  • Start-up mentality: things move fast, nothing is perfect, you adapt


What you'll get:

  • Part-time flexible hours
  • Base pay + commission on every deal you help close - paid in Reais

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Mobile Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking to bring on board a Senior Mobile Engineer with a deep understanding of native iOS development and cross-platform development using Kotlin Multiplatform. This role requires a strong grasp of software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop, and maintain complex mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities


  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate mobile and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.


Technology Requirements


  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience as a mobile engineer specializing in iOS application development.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience developing user interfaces with SwiftUI.
  • Minimum of 1 year of practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform for building cross-platform mobile applications.
  • Proficient in both Swift and Kotlin programming languages.
  • Solid understanding and practical application of architectural patterns such as MVC, MVVM, and Clean Architecture.
  • Proven experience integrating Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices with mobile applications.
  • Experience developing and deploying applications that utilize the Apple Watch and integrate with HealthKit for data collection.
  • Demonstrated experience navigating the submission and issue resolution processes for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile application. Experience utilizing tools like Git, Fastlane, XCode Cloud, and Jenkins.
  • Experience writing comprehensive unit, integration, and UI tests for both iOS and Android applications.


Profile Requirements


  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.
  • A passion for fitness is a plus.
